name: Shindou-san no Yuuutsu: Toki o Kakeru Otome
original_name: 進藤さんの憂鬱 時をかける乙女
source:
The stage is set one year after Yuki's ending from "Sakurayuki".

Obviously, Kenji and Sakura are still madly in love.

But Shintou is still lonely.

Who'd have expected him to warp through time and arrive in the past!?

A past in which Kenji and Sakura haven't started dating yet.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE031569.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
舞台设定在《樱雪》中由纪结束一年后。

显然，健二和小樱仍然热恋着。

但新都还是很孤独。

谁能想到他竟然穿越时空来到了过去！？

贤二和小樱还没有开始约会的过去。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE031569.html]DLsite English[/url]]
